title: Recursive paired linear form
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, and let $L_{r,k}$ be a linear functional on $(\mathbb{F}_2)^{r+2k}$. Set $L_{r,0}=0$. Recursively, for $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^{r+2k+2}$, set $L_{r,k+1}(x)=L_{r,k}(x_{\le r+2k})+\sum_{i=0}^{r+2k-1}(x_{\le r+2k})_i$, where $x_{\le r+2k}$ denotes the vector formed by the first $r+2k$ coordinates of $x$ and the sum is in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: the vectors have the stated finite dimensions over $\mathbb{F}_2$
